head_commit.message:
docs(record): log the CMAnchor-2026-11-10 round in CHANGELOG + CURRENT.md and file its gate evidence

Front page: CURRENT.md gains a standing block for this round (c-M anchor labelling, defect D9
resolved, 51 reference entries) and its refresh line now reads 2026-11-10. VERSION is deliberately
NOT advanced, so the record save point stays v19.2-F-RecordSave-v1.18 and the tag guard
(test_version_tokens_have_tags.py) stays satisfied. CHANGELOG gains the [CMAnchor-2026-11-10]
section naming the seven commits, the ln(10) scatter error in c_M_tension_sigma, the withdrawn
"3.2σ -> 0.32σ" headline and the corrected +0.75σ (Diemer+ 2019) / +2.06σ (Ohana+ 2026 own
relation) / 1.10σ anchor-independent statements.

Evidence: docs/dual_review_5loop/evidence_CMAnchor_20261110/ holds the 15/15 gate log for d362721,
the same day's exit-1 gate log kept for comparison, the standalone audit logs (units, doc anchors,
paper regression), the Round-13 self-check 8/8, an unfiltered run of v0.3-prelim/tests
(3684 passed / 25 skipped / 0 failed, which covers the 40 tests the gate deselects), a re-derivation
of the c-M sigmas from scripts/elbert2015_c_tau_prescription.py cross-checked against the result
artifact they are quoted from (difference 0.00e+00), and the push read-back. No file uses a .log
extension, because .gitignore line 78 would silently keep it untracked.

Index: docs/dual_review_5loop/README.md now lists evidence_n27_20261108 and evidence_n28_20261108,
which existed but were never indexed, plus the new folder.

Verified before committing: doc guards 20 passed (markup balance, finding-id uniqueness, version-tag
pairing, t82 version drift); audit_markdown_tables, audit_stale_strings, audit_doc_anchors and
audit_claims all PASS; t82_audit 120/120 ALL CLEAR.

head_commit.message:
docs(paper): adopt anchor-labelled c-M headline in the abstract, register [58], clear audit findings

Abstract: add the Cloud-9 c-M tension as a headline number (not a third structural result).
Under the Elbert+ 2015 c-tau prescription the framework places Cloud-9 at c_200 = 6.0 vs
Ohana+ 2026's measured 4.0: +2.06 sigma on Ohana+ 2026's own c-M relation (implied median
12.81), +0.75 sigma on Diemer+ 2019 (median 7.90), i.e. a 1.10 sigma / 0.176 dex reduction
that is reduced, not resolved. Withdraws the "3.2 sigma -> 0.32 sigma" phrasing (cross-relation
subtraction + ln(10) scatter-convention error) and states that every c-M sigma names its relation.

Reference list: add [58] Despali+ 2025, "Introducing the AIDA-TNG project", A&A 697, A213,
arXiv:2501.12439v2, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202553836 — the paper already KB-verified under the
evidence-pack label [29a]; records its transfer limit (SIDM cases at sigma/m = 1 cm2/g and the
Correa+ 2021 form, no concentration quoted below M_vir ~ 1e10 Msun, so no number transfers to
Cloud-9). Reference count corrected 50 -> 51 (recounted 2026-11-10).

Audit findings cleared:
- 9 dangling "registry §7.11 DN" pointers -> "registry defect DN" (audit_doc_anchors)
- dead "(see §5 cross-link)" -> "(see §3.2c cross-link)"
- ASCII M_sun -> M☉ in the [44] entry (audit_units)
- test_paper_v19_regression: the [29] assertion pinned the pre-2026-11-09 marker text
  "currently NOT cited in this draft"; now asserts the 2026-11-05 marker plus >=4 occurrences
  of [29] (3 body sites since 2026-11-09 + the entry)
- registry D9 records the applied resolution; KB entry records the [58] <-> [29a] mapping

Verification: audit_units PASS; audit_doc_anchors PASS; test_paper_v19_regression 10 passed;
run_round13_self_check.py 8/8 consistency layers PASS.

head_commit.message:
docs(kb): full numerical read of AIDA-TNG intro paper arXiv:2501.12439 [29a]

Records the paper's own numbers with extract line anchors: run table (m_DM =
3.6e6 Msun best), HMF (alpha=2.7/beta=0.99 DMO fit, alpha=-0.82 FP fit, SIDM
+5-10% below 1e11 Msun in FP only), profiles and c-M (SIDM cores ~10 kpc at
1e13 and ~30 kpc at 1e14 Msun, cuspy below 1e12; WDM cores at M ~ 100 M_hm),
galaxy sizes +20%, P(k) -10% at k=20 and -30% at k>200 h/Mpc for SIDM1.

Adds the transfer limits: AIDA's SIDM cases are sigma/m = 1 cm2/g constant and
Correa+ 2021 velocity-dependent, both outside the v19.2-F 50-483 cm2/g regime,
so no AIDA number may be carried to Cloud-9. Usable without extrapolation: the
NFW-vs-Einasto profile-family statement in the same suite (backing the Y24
profile-family caveat), and the sign of the SIDM c-M effect at galaxy mass.
Registry row 475 status updated.

head_commit.message:
docs(references): apply 5 verified reference slots to the paper + fix 2 wrong venues

Reference slots added to PAPER_V1_DRAFT.md (43 -> 48 entries) with body citations:
  [44] Navarro+Frenk+White 1997, ApJ 490, 493 (astro-ph/9611107, doi:10.1086/304888)
       -> cited in the Sec 2.6 V_max=31.12 footnote; closes defect D3 (NFW used 49x
          in the body with no Navarro entry). Convention: cite 1997, not 1996, because
          the framework's rho_crit=1.381e-7 Msun/pc^3 and c_200=r_200/r_s follow its
          critical-density normalisation.
  [46] Navarro+Frenk+White 1996, ApJ 462, 563 (astro-ph/9508025, doi:10.1086/177173)
       -> companion only, carries the H_0=50 convention warning; degraded text layer.
  [47] Burkert 1995, ApJ 447, L25 (astro-ph/9504041, doi:10.1086/309560)
       -> cited in Sec 2.6d "Prescription B: Burkert-style", which named the paper with
          volume and page but had no entry. Page from the arXiv journal_ref; Crossref and
          OpenAlex give vol 447/1995 with no page field.
  [48] Despali+ 2026 AIDA-TNG profiles, A&A 708, A47 (arXiv:2512.15869v2)
       -> cited in Sec 5 as the profile-family caveat on the 7sigma -> 3sigma c-M claim.
  [53] Yang+Yu+An 2020, PRL 125, 111105 (arXiv:2002.02102)
       -> cited in Sec 5 as the published precedent (DF2: CDM needs c_200=4, "4sigma below
          the median of the concentration-mass relation"), with the scatter-convention
          caveat before 4sigma and 7sigma are ever compared.

Corrections (self-discovered, disclosed in the registry):
  - D4 was wrong: Burkert 1995 DOES have an arXiv preprint (astro-ph/9504041). Unpaywall
    and Semantic Scholar both map DOI 10.1086/309560 to it. PDF downloaded + read; new
    KB record 9504041_burkert_1995.md (abstract-level: preprint scan is degraded).
  - New D8: the draft asks five times for a "Burkert+ 2020 c-tau prescription" and says none
    was found. Burkert 2020 exists (ApJ 904, 161, doi:10.3847/1538-4357/abb242) but is a
    fuzzy-DM core paper with no SIDM c-tau fit; Burkert+Forbes 2020 (AJ 159, 56) likewise
    cannot fill the slot. The recommendation as named is unimplementable; v40.43a already
    superseded it with Sameie+ 2020 [54c].
  - AUDIT_REFERENCES.md venues fixed: [29a] Introducing AIDA-TNG is A&A 697, A213 (2025),
    not "MNRAS ... (2024)"; [29b] AIDA-TNG profiles is A&A 708, A47, not A&A 699, A222
    (699/A222 is a different paper). The file's own summary table already had 708/A47.

Gates re-run after the edits: check_fabrication OK; audit_citation_provenance 47 body
citations / 48 entries, all body citations resolve (only [29] uncited, pre-existing);
audit_claims PASS. bash -n on download_papers.sh OK (9504041 mapping added).
